name: Uni-Language Ascendant
description: Original Ascendant intro, nine menu languages, Back and Reset profile. Uninstalling deletes the mod profile; reinstalling starts fresh. German ROM profiles for all 11 Gen1–Gen3 editions; Emerald also French, Italian and Spanish. Compile once from your own language ROM; exact US base required. Based on Gen1Recomp by BOIS CLUB GAMES, LLC (https://github.com/bryanthaboi/gen1recomp)
